=== Armed conflicts and attacks ===
*[[Middle Eastern crisis (2023–present)|Middle Eastern crisis]]
**[[Israeli–Palestinian conflict]]
***[[Gaza war|Israel–Hamas war]]
****At least 40 people are killed and more than 100 others are injured in Israeli airstrikes against residential buildings in [[Deir al-Balah]] in the central [[Gaza Strip]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2024/2/23/at-least-40-people-killed-in-central-gaza-as-israel-touts-post-war-plan (Al Jazeera)]
***One Israeli is killed and 11 others are injured in an automatic weapons shooting attack by three Palestinians from Bethlehem near the az-Za'ayyem checkpoint on Route 1, close to the [[Israeli settlement]] of [[Ma'ale Adumim]] in the [[occupied]] [[West Bank]]. Security forces and armed civilians kill two gunmen at the scene, while the third is captured after being neutralized following a chase. [https://www.thenationalnews.com/mena/palestine-israel/2024/02/22/three-shot-dead-in-west-bank-violence/ (''The National News'')] [https://www.timesofisrael.com/one-killed-11-wounded-in-terror-shooting-attack-near-jerusalem-checkpoint/?utm_source=article_hpsidebar&utm_medium=desktop_site (''Times of Israel'')]
**[[Hezbollah–Israel conflict (2023–present)|Israel–Hezbollah conflict]]
***An anti-tank missile launched from [[Lebanon]] strikes a home in [[Yuval]] in [[northern Israel]], causing a fire but no injuries. [https://www.timesofisrael.com/idf-strikes-southern-lebanon-after-anti-tank-missile-hits-home-in-north/ (''Times of Israel'')]
***Two [[Hezbollah]] militants are killed and three others are injured in an Israeli drone strike targeting an apartment building in [[Kfar Remen]], [[Southern Lebanon|southern Lebanon]]. [https://www.timesofisrael.com/idf-strikes-southern-lebanon-after-anti-tank-missile-hits-home-in-north/ (''Times of Israel'')]
**[[Red Sea crisis]]
***A [[Palau]]-flagged [[cargo ship]], the MV ''Islander'', is set on fire in the [[Gulf of Aden]] after being [[Houthi attacks on commercial vessels|hit]] by two [[anti-ship missile]]s fired by [[Yemen]]'s [[Houthis|Houthi movement]]. One sailor is wounded, but the vessel continues on its course. [https://apnews.com/article/israel-yemen-houthi-hamas-war-gaza-strip-216c0bde5f79ed857f1f5ef7f157a66b (AP)]
*[[Sudanese civil war (2023–present)|Sudanese civil war]]
**[[Famine in Sudan (2024–present)|Famine in Sudan]]
***The [[World Food Programme]] releases a report stating that more than 95% of [[Sudan]]'s population cannot afford a meal a day. [https://www.barrons.com/news/over-95-percent-of-sudanese-cannot-afford-a-meal-a-day-wfp-fef7c4a0 (''Barron's'')]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[2024 Guangzhou bridge collapse]]
**Five people are killed when a barge collides with the {{ill|Lixinsha Bridge|zh|沥心沙大桥}} in [[Guangzhou]], [[China]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/china/two-killed-after-barge-hits-bridge-near-chinas-guangzhou-plunging-vehicles-water-2024-02-22/ (Reuters)] [https://www.nytimes.com/2024/02/22/world/asia/china-bridge-collapse-ship.html (''The New York Times'')] 
*[[2024 València residential complex fire]]
**Nine people are killed, 15 others are injured and one is missing during a fire at a 14-storey residential building in [[Valencia]], [[Spain]]. [https://apnews.com/article/spain-building-fire-valencia-8446652daa7f45607272df09f6ae0748 (AP)]
*At least eight people are killed during [[flood]]s and [[landslide]]s in the [[Brazilian state]] of [[Rio de Janeiro (state)|Rio de Janeiro]]. [https://apnews.com/article/brazil-rio-de-janeiro-floods-landslides-6a3a68abeab951cfbd8be79a79ae9fe2 (AP)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[Murder of Kathleen Jo Henry]]
**An [[Alaska|Alaskan]] jury finds Brian Smith guilty of the murder of Kathleen Jo Henry and Veronica Abouchuk. [https://abcnews.go.com/US/verdict-reached-double-murder-trial-2-native-alaskan/story?id=107453758 (ABC News)]
*A court in [[Panama]] orders the arrest of former president [[Ricardo Martinelli]], who is under protection of the [[Nicaragua]]n embassy in [[Panama City]]. [https://abcnews.go.com/International/wireStory/panamas-judiciary-orders-arrest-president-holed-nicaraguas-embassy-107465348 (ABC News)]
*A majority of citizens of [[Westlock]] voted to ban public display of pride flags.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.losangelesblade.com/2024/02/23/canadian-town-narrowly-votes-to-ban-pride-flags/|title=Canadian town narrowly votes to ban Pride flags}}</ref>

'''Science and technology'''
*[[2024 AT&T outage]]
**More than 71,000 customers of [[United States|US]] [[Mobile network operator|mobile carrier]] [[AT&T]] experience network outages. Some [[Verizon]] and [[T-Mobile]] users also report outages. [https://www.cnn.com/2024/02/22/tech/att-cell-service-outage/index.html (CNN)] [https://www.nbcnews.com/news/us-news/t-verizon-t-mobile-customers-hit-widespread-cellular-outages-us-rcna139938 (NBC News)]
*[[Intuitive Machines]] [[Intuitive Machines Nova-C|Nova-C]] [[lunar lander]] [[IM-1|''Odysseus'']] successfully touches down on the [[Moon]], near the [[lunar south pole]], making it the first private company to successfully land a spacecraft on the surface of the Moon.
